title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Disputes Desk Rules — Late Payment Charge Relief While an Invoice Dispute Is Open
content:
When an invoice dispute stood open on a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account on the statement date, the statement late payment charge is computed at a monthly percentage reduced by a dispute relief.

## Which dispute is read

The dispute relief is set by the most recently filed invoice dispute on the account — the invoice dispute request with the latest filing date, whatever its status. That dispute was open on the statement date when it was filed on or before the statement date and was still unresolved on the statement date: it had no resolution date, or its resolution date is after the statement date. A dispute resolved on the statement date itself was not open on it.

## Dispute relief

| Most recently filed invoice dispute | The business's active Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership | Dispute relief |
|---|---|---|
| Open on the statement date | ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum or ProBuild Platinum Elite | 0.25 percentage points (Gold dispute relief) |
| Open on the statement date | No Gold or higher membership (ProBuild Member, Bronze or Silver, or no active membership) | 0.10 percentage points (standard dispute relief) |
| Not open on the statement date, or no dispute on file | Any | Zero |

The dispute relief is taken, in percentage points, from the tier's monthly late payment charge percentage; the monthly percentage the charge is computed at never falls below zero.

## Cases (hypothetical statement dated 28 February)

| Most recent dispute filed | Resolved | Open on 28 February |
|---|---|---|
| 10 February | not yet | Yes |
| 10 February | 3 March | Yes |
| 10 February | 28 February | No |
| 1 March | not yet | No — filed after the statement date |
